head_commit.message:
test(visual): refresh 6 stale Linux baseline snapshots

CI's HS Visual Regression gate has been red on dev for 8+ days.

Root cause: two independent, already-landed source/test changes never
got matching --update-snapshots runs against the Linux (chromium-linux)
baselines CI actually checks:

- hubspot-booking-form-required-validation (desktop+mobile): a prior
  commit (30b76f5c) added hideToastsForSnapshot() to the test, hiding
  the error-summary toast before capture. Baseline still shows the old
  visible-toast state.
- health-dialog-select-menu-layering (desktop) + insurance-hero/
  insurance-carousel/insurance-features-carousel (mobile): minor
  typography/spacing drift from unrelated landed commits, never
  reflected in the Linux baseline (a macOS/-darwin baseline existed
  and was fine; the Linux one used by CI was stale).

Regenerated via `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.59.1-noble` on
linux/amd64 (matches CI's ubuntu-latest runner) to avoid introducing
cross-platform font-rendering drift. Full suite verified green
(89/89) after the update.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(forms): forward hubspotutk cookie to forms proxy for attribution

submitToHubSpotProxyResponse sent only pageUri/pageName in context,
never context.hutk. HubSpot couldn't link submissions to the tracking
session, so leads from paid traffic were attributed DIRECT_TRAFFIC
with hs_google_click_id=null instead of PAID_SEARCH. All 14 React
form components share this function, so the fix covers all of them.

Backend (hubspot-forms-service) already accepts ContextDto.hutk and
forwards it via sanitizeContext — only the frontend was missing it.
